# AgentOre v0.0.11

This release automatically settles the previous reward-bearing epoch when it is ready to finalize.

- detects a non-empty, unfinalized previous epoch during the existing periodic refresh;
- submits finalization automatically when the dedicated local wallet has Base ETH;
- keeps automatic finalization independently configurable through `autoFinalize`;
- preserves the action-required badge and provides actionable feedback when automatic settlement needs attention;
- reports a finalization transaction as submitted until the updated onchain state is observed.

The app requires macOS 14 or newer. This release is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.
